name: Equal groups with manipulatives
description: Build equal groups with counters or other objects so multiplication and division refer to visible quantities.

name: Array
description: Arrange equal groups in rows and columns to connect repeated groups with multiplication facts.

name: Number line
description: Represent equal jumps, order and relative magnitude on a number line.

name: Part-whole bar model
description: Represent a whole as bars partitioned into known and unknown parts.

name: Comparison bar model
description: Align bars to show two quantities and their difference or multiplicative relationship.

name: Multiplication and division notation
description: Use multiplication and division symbols, fact families and equations after concrete or pictorial meaning is established.

name: Fraction strips
description: Use equal-length strips partitioned into equal parts to compare and build equivalent fractions.

name: Part-whole area model
description: Partition a single whole into equal regions and shade selected parts to represent fractions.

name: Fraction notation
description: Represent fractions symbolically with numerator and denominator after their part-whole meaning is established.
